resolution_semantics.epistemic_resolution: Whether the estimand, identifiability boundary, required observations, forbidden proxy substitutions, and completion condition have been specified well enough to make the question falsifiable.
resolution_semantics.empirical_resolution: Whether a qualifying real system has actually supplied the required observations and established the empirical causal claim.
resolution_semantics.paper_boundary: The current microdonta Methods claim requires epistemic resolution of these inherited questions, not empirical confirmation of all three ecological claims.

tracks.closure_object: signed_position = plant_matching_trait - pollinator_functional_center, with compatible units and outcome-blind sign convention
tracks.empirical_completion_trigger: A prespecified real comparison supplies plant trait, source-native pollinator functional center, compatible signed mapping, downstream response, hierarchy and uncertainty.

tracks.closure_object: effective_service = sum_k(visitor_rate_k * direct_effectiveness_k); abundance, identity, richness and degree are proxies unless calibrated
tracks.empirical_completion_trigger: One matched hierarchy supplies visitor-specific rates, direct per-visit effectiveness, local context and downstream reproductive outcome.

tracks.closure_object: pollinator functional change -> effective service -> reproductive dependency/autonomous assurance -> downstream response, with every middle link observed rather than inferred
tracks.empirical_completion_trigger: At least one independent system supplies all four links on the same or prespecified compatible units with hierarchy, uncertainty and provenance.
